answer: Escrowed bonds and a referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 50-coin bond and appears as a vertex in the graph. Peers may dispute a cluster, the graph acting as a lantern over sponsor links; if review finds forged referrals, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses its bond too. Forging 1,000 identities spirals costs to 50,000 coins, while an honest agent pays one bond, recoverable after 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
